[Connecting to the camera with the NFC]

If the connection attempt fails, follow these steps to create a manual connection:
1. Start MobileLink on the camera.
2. Select a camera model from the Wi-Fi setting of the smartphone.
3. Start MobileLink on the smartphone.
Do not display this tip again.
Your smart phone will continue to receive files even if you return to the home screen.
Press the back button again to exit.
Application will close due to insufficient memory.
The camera canceled the connection.\nEnsure that the camera is available.
The camera is already connected to a smartphone.\nOnly one smartphone can be connected at a time.\n(If no smartphone is connected to the camera, try the connection again with the NFC feature.)
If the camera does not connect automatically, try manual connection on the menu.
If the camera has been connected before, it connects automatically.
Waiting for automatic connection to the Samsung camera.
The application connects a smart phone to a Samsung Smart camera wirelessly to receive files or capture images remotely.
You can use the following features conveniently by connecting a Samsung smart camera and smartphone wirelessly.
The feature shares photos or videos from the camera to a smart phone.\nYou can select files from the camera or smart phone and share them with the smart phone.
When you capture photos from your camera, the feature allows your smart phone to receive photos directly.
This feature allows you to capture photos remotely and shows your camera\'s viewfinder.
This mode allows you to connect a smartphone to your camera and copy captured photos and videos from the camera to multiple smartphones.

If the connection attempt fails, follow these steps to create a manual connection or ensure the following:

[Manual connection]
1. Start the wireless function on the camera.
2. Select a camera model from the Wi-Fi setting of the smartphone.
3. Start Samsung Smart Camera App. on the smartphone.

[Note]
1. If options such as 'Disconnect weak Wi-Fi signal' or 'Disconnect abnormal AP' are selected in the Wi-Fi setting, the connection attempt may fail.
2. If the carrier’s automatic Wi-Fi application is running, disable the automatic connection option.
3. Check whether other manufacturers' camera connection applications or other applications that may interrupt the Wi-Fi connection are installed on the smartphone.

This application allows you to view previews of images from your camera on a smartphone and capture photos wirelessly. Photos are saved in your camera and smartphone, and you can copy desired photos to the smartphone.

If the connection attempt fails, follow these steps to create a manual connection:
1. Start Remote Viewfinder on the camera.
2. Select a camera model from the Wi-Fi Setting of the smartphone.
3. Start Remote Viewfinder on the smartphone.
